## Pull request overview

This PR fixes a CI test failure caused by some packages pulling in broken published versions of `@object-ui/core@0.3.1`, which contained invalid ES module exports (`export * from './types'` instead of the correct `export type { ... } from './types/index.js'`).

**Changes:**
- Updated three package.json files to use `workspace:*` dependencies instead of published version references
- Regenerated pnpm-lock.yaml to reflect the workspace dependency changes, removing all references to broken published packages

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-form/package.json | Changed `@object-ui/data-objectstack` from `^0.3.1` to `workspace:*` in devDependencies |
| packages/plugin-grid/package.json | Changed `@object-ui/data-objectstack` from `^0.3.1` to `workspace:*` in devDependencies |
| apps/console/package.json | Changed `@object-ui/layout` from `^0.1.1` to `workspace:*` in dependencies |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Removed all published package entries for @object-ui packages and updated to use workspace links |

<details>
<summary>Files not reviewed (1)</summary>

* **pnpm-lock.yaml**: Language not supported
</details>
